body:
Found by an adversarial review pass over the SVG-compositing fix
(fix/spa-svg-animation-main-thread). Pre-existing; the fix did not introduce it
and deliberately did not change it, because an a11y change belongs in a change
with its own a11y verification rather than smuggled into a perf fix.

lucide-react 0.460.0 does NOT add `aria-hidden` or `focusable` by default, so a
decorative icon is only hidden if the call site says so. The project's own
convention says every decorative lucide icon is explicitly hidden — most call
sites do it. These do not:

- `frontend/src/pages/Catalog.tsx` — `<RefreshCw size={15} />` (button already
  has `aria-label` "Refresh library")
- `frontend/src/pages/CoverPicker.tsx` — `<RefreshCw size={14} />` beside the
  text "Refresh"; `<Loader2 size={22} />` beside "Searching every source…";
  `<Loader2 size={18} />` alone in `.cardShimmer`; `<Loader2 size={14} />` at
  three Button call sites beside "Use this cover" / "Upload as cover"
- `frontend/src/pages/Reader.tsx` — `<Loader2 size={36} />` alone in
  `.fullCenter`; `<Loader2 size={32} />` alone in `.viewerOverlay`

Two distinct cases, and they want different remedies:

1. Icon beside text or inside a labelled button (Catalog, and CoverPicker's
   Refresh / Use this cover / Upload as cover / Searching every source). Purely
   decorative — add `aria-hidden="true" focusable={false}` and it is done.
2. Icon that is the ONLY content of a loading state (`CoverPicker` cardShimmer,
   `Reader` fullCenter, `Reader` viewerOverlay). Hiding it is not enough: today
   the loading state is announced to nobody at all, because an `<svg>` with no
   role and no name is already ignored. These want a real status affordance
   (`role="status"` + a visually-hidden label), the way `components/Spinner.tsx`
   already does it with `role="status" aria-label={t('Loading')}`.

Note the sibling icons on the same CoverPicker lines (`<Check size={14} />`,
`<UploadIcon size={14} />`) are missing the attributes too and belong in the
same sweep.
title: Nine decorative lucide icons in the SPA carry neither aria-hidden nor focusable={false}
